meta.title: TFLN rib waveguide mode lattice (F2-15)
meta.engine: eo-modulator-atlas engine (github.com/jwt625/eo-modulator-atlas, engine/, GPL-3.0-or-later): full-vector FEM, Nedelec/Lagrange order 2, auto window mesh (meshScale 1), shift-invert block Arnoldi
meta.stack: LN film (thickness t) on SiO2 BOX, SiO2 cladding over the whole cross-section (rib embedded); window holds LN and SiO2 only (no Si substrate: substrate leakage not modelled; no electrodes)

orientation.x: x-cut, propagation along crystal y; lab x (lateral) = crystal z, so TE sees n_e
orientation.z: z-cut, propagation along crystal x; lab y (normal) = crystal z, so TM sees n_e

meta.geometry: rib top width w; etch depth t * etch; sidewall angle from horizontal (bottom width w + 2 t etch / tan(angle)); slab t (1 - etch) outside the rib, none at etch = 1

materials.LN: Zelmon, Small, Jundt, JOSA B 14, 3319 (1997), doi:10.1364/JOSAB.14.003319, congruent LN, 21 C, Sellmeier (engine library, refractiveindex.info transcription; identical coefficients to data/dispersion/zelmon1997.yaml); status P-db
materials.SiO2: Malitson, JOSA 55, 1205 (1965), doi:10.1364/JOSA.55.001205, fused silica, used for BOX and cladding (approximation for thermal / deposited oxide); status P-db

meta.window: x in +-(w_bottom/2 + 0.3 + 1.1 lambda) um, y in [-(0.25 + 1.1 lambda), t + 0.25 + 1.1 lambda] um, PEC (zero tangential E) on the window edge; enlarged once to 3.5 field decay lengths (lateral: own-polarization slab index; vertical: SiO2) when a bound labelled mode has > 1e-2 of its power within 10 % of the edge

definitions.n_g: group index, engine first-order perturbation incl. material dispersion of both Sellmeier fits
definitions.a_eff_um2: (int |E|^2 dA)^2 / int |E|^4 dA over the window, E incl. E_z (engine effectiveAreaUm2)
definitions.ln_fraction: Poynting power fraction in LN (slab + rib)

meta.tracking: labels by dominant polarization, assembled from the stored per-mode summaries (no re-solve): among candidate modes (above the cladding index + 1e-4, and bound or >= 50 % of |E_t|^2 within |x| <= w_bottom/2 + lambda/4), TE family = TE fraction > 0.5, TM family = the rest; within a family n_eff order (TE0 above TE1; TM0 = highest TM-family mode). Width tracking (transverse-E overlap with the previous width, w ascending) only orders near-degenerate neighbours in a family (n_eff gap < 0.0005) and sets TRACK_LOW / REIDENTIFIED. Solve-time labels (overlap tracking from a symmetry-class seed) are kept in the logs; POL_RELABELED marks where they differ

flags.legend: NOT_CONVERGED: eigen residual >= 1e-6; WINDOW_EDGE: power within 10 % of the window edge > 1e-2 after one window enlargement; LEAKY: n_eff below the outer-slab fundamental index of the mode's own dominant polarization (symmetric anisotropic slab, modes.ts slabIndex) or below the cladding index (not bound); CROSS_LEAKY: bound, but below the other polarization's slab index (lateral leakage by polarization conversion possible; in the closed window such modes can mix with slab box modes); TRACK_LOW: overlap with the previous width's same-label mode 0.5-0.9, or not available in the stored overlaps; REIDENTIFIED: that overlap < 0.5 (the label moves to another mode between widths); POL_RELABELED: label assigned to a different mode than the solve-time overlap tracking (provenance; values are those of the relabelled mode); POL_HYBRID: 0.3 < TE fraction < 0.7, strongly hybrid, TE / TM label ambiguous

meta.grid_note: 7 x 5 x 10 x 3 x 3 x 2 = 6300 solves; polarization is not a solve axis (one full-vector solve gives TE and TM families); width nodes geometric 0.6 * 5^(i/9) um

reference.note: li2026aa geometry (300 nm film, 180 nm etch, 3.5 um top width, 60 deg, x-cut TE0, 1550 nm). lib: lattice stack and window with library indices; cfg: sims/li2026aa/config.yaml indices (n_o 2.211, n_e 2.138, SiO2 1.444, library slopes) and optical window. Engine value of the li2026aa eo_overlap arm A: n_eff 1.7695566, n_g 2.1351030 (static/data/eo-overlap-li2026aa.json). w = 3.5 um lies outside the lattice width axis.

heldout.sampling: uniform t 300-900 nm, etch 0.2-1.0, w 0.6-3.0 um, sidewall 60-80 deg; lambda and cut uniform over the grid values (prng.ts xorshift128)
heldout.labels: direct solves relabelled with the lattice rule (polarization family, n_eff order; no width tracking for single points)
heldout.clean: query valid, tracked, not hybrid (interpolated TE fraction 0.1-0.9 or POL_HYBRID at a node); direct solve without LEAKY / WINDOW_EDGE / NOT_CONVERGED and TE fraction > 0.9 or < 0.1; flagged = comparable minus clean
